description: Physics-lumped hoist dynamics: mass raised/lowered through height h stores E=m*g*h. Newton's 2nd law ODE for mass position/velocity with motor/generator torque, winch drum inertia, cable, Coulomb friction and aerodynamic drag. Round-trip efficiency from motor/generator electrical losses + mechanical losses. Solid-mass tower / mineshaft hoist (Energy Vault class).
source: Botha & Kamper (2019), J. Energy Storage, 23, 159-174; Berrada et al. (2017), Energy Conversion & Management, 137, 191-200; Tong et al. (2022), J. Energy Storage, 53, 105226 (gravity energy storage review); Pyrhonen et al. (2013), Design of Rotating Electrical Machines, Wiley (machine loss model)

unit.name: Generic Solid-Mass Gravity Storage (e.g. Energy Vault tower / mineshaft hoist)
unit.source: Botha & Kamper (2019); Berrada et al. (2017); Tong et al. (2022)

h_max_m.note: Maximum lift height (top of tower / shaft head)

drum_radius_m.note: Winch drum radius (maps drum torque to cable force, tau = F*r)

drum_inertia_kgm2.note: Lumped rotational inertia of drum + gearbox + rotor referred to drum shaft

motor_gen_plf_exp.note: Part-load loss exponent n (n=2 typical induction machine)

friction_coeff.note: Coulomb friction coefficient at guide rails: F_fric = mu*m*g*sign(v)

bearing_loss_frac.note: Bearing/seal parasitic loss as fraction of transmitted mechanical power
